description: Περιφέρεια Κρήτης: earthquake hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Περιφέρεια Κρήτης. Coverage: Περιφέρεια Κρήτης. The listing groups 8 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about earthquake hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Σεισμικά επίκεντρα μεγέθους μεγαλύτερου των 6 Ρίχτερ; Σεισμικά επίκεντρα μεγέθους μικρότερου των 6 Ρίχτερ; Μόνιμο Σεισμολογικό Δίκτυο; Στοιχεία Σεισμικών Γεγονότων. Formats seen: XML, WMS, GEOJSON, KML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
